acceptance_policy: The local HFSS reference must pass the explicit 38 GHz resonance, approximately -30 dB minimum, and 36.5-39.5 GHz band gate before it becomes a candidate-comparison baseline.
If the local reference fails, revise only a versioned engineering assumption; do not silently tune a paper-explicit dimension.
The generated candidate and reference must be solved in the same AEDT/PyAEDT environment before curve RMSE is evaluated.
